Package com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.config.http

Class KfeHttpClientConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.config.http.KfeHttpClientConfiguration
@Configuration @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.standalone", havingValue="true") public class KfeHttpClientConfiguration extends Object
Configures standalone HTTP clients for custody providers, Bitcoin Core, and LND REST. External rail clients use bounded timeouts; Bitcoin Core gets a longer read deadline for UTXO scans.

    • lndRestTemplate

      @Bean("lndRestTemplate") public org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate lndRestTemplate(org.springframework.boot.web.client.RestTemplateBuilder builder, @Value("${lightning.lnd.tls.insecure:false}") boolean tlsInsecure)
      LND REST is always HTTPS. Local/dev clusters often use the self-signed LND cert; when lightning.lnd.tls.insecure=true (or legacy LIGHTNING_LND_TLS_ENABLED=false mapped to that property), skip certificate verification so KFE can reach LND. In insecure mode both certificate trust and hostname verification are disabled.
      Parameters:
      builder - Spring RestTemplate builder
      tlsInsecure - explicit opt-in to trust-all TLS for LND only
      Returns:
      LND client, configured with standard timeouts and the selected TLS verification policy
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when insecure TLS context setup fails
